description: IN: S03’s amber zero-line hum continues (same line, same tone)
an arrowhead grows on the right end of the line
the line swings up −90° to vertical: future is UP (peak of the swing ~f34)
gold dust starts streaming out of the tail point (granular stream, rising until f104)
width bracket 1 measures the plume
width bracket 2
width bracket 3
width bracket 4 (widest, near the arrowhead)
the flow clock stalls (the dust stops at ~f110, then runs backward)
◀◀ appears top-left, chromatic split on the dust
the dust runs backward and narrows into the tail (reversed granular stream)
the camera dives into the tail point (accelerating rush until f188)
the last dust is swallowed by the tail point — soft gathered thump, the point flares
the tail point opens (iris with a gold rim) onto the present-day cosmos
falling Shepard tone starts: cosmic rewind (until the slam)
monumental look-back counter appears (top): 1 天
odometer whirr 1天 → 年 → 万年 → 亿年
unit flips to 年
unit flips to 万年
space contracts: field galaxies converge, the merger remnant un-merges (low rumble until f240)
unit flips to 亿年 — from here the cosmos itself starts to change
亿年 digits whirr toward 136 (until f258)
first stars un-light (4 clusters, bottom) — reversed plink
un-ignition cluster (20 clusters, bottom-right) — reversed plink
the last stars go out (10 clusters, top-right) — reversed plink
the dark ages (136 → 137亿年): everything dims for a beat
the heat surge (137 → 138亿年): red → orange → white-hot plasma, roar builds to the slam
SLAM — the floor of time: counter lands on 138亿年, flash, shock ring, camera shake
the counter flies into the HUD (◀◀ 138亿年)
boiling plasma bed (sustained until the darkness at f370)
HUD types 涨落 ×10⁵ 放大
darkness falls over the plasma (low-pass); the base “10” emerges as a window of plasma
the base “10” lands, bursting out of frame (kick, flash, shake)
exponent “10” pops (higher pitch)
exponent “123” pops (higher still)
note 彭罗斯估算 types in
camera pulls back to the whole fraction
the fraction bar draws, 1 and 概率 ≈ appear
the wall of zeros types in, accelerating into a whirr (until f494)
the darkness lifts: the uniform plasma returns
the temperature probe draws its flat trace (thin, steady = uniform)
whiteout of the plasma
dissolve into S01’s spent ink: underwater hush, cream light table
S墨 appears at the TOP of the gauge, S宇宙 at the bottom — the contradiction
the two thought-experiment boxes draw on in ink
the gas in both boxes jiggles (soft)
gravity on: the right box’s gas falls together
first light sparks leave the heated clump (sparks continue to ~f700)
left box slides away, right box swells to fill the frame and dissolves
the whole spent-ink universe starts to gather into filaments (deep swell until f790)
the clump settles (soft thud); its S tick has climbed
▶ 38万年
the paper goes dark from the bottom up: ink becomes light (sub drop, until f758)
deep swell of the ignition era (until f808)
▶ 2亿年
first cluster ignites (2 clusters, heaviest bottom): flash + shock ring + spikes
ignition cascade (3 clusters, heaviest bottom-right): flash + shock ring + spikes
滚落 slides down the slope (second glyph f766)
ignition cascade (3 clusters, heaviest centre-left): flash + shock ring + spikes
groups ignite (second, finer wave of sparkles until ~f800)
ignition cascade (3 clusters, heaviest top): flash + shock ring + spikes
ignition cascade (1 cluster, heaviest bottom): flash + shock ring + spikes
▶ 10亿年
ignition cascade (1 cluster, heaviest top-right): flash + shock ring + spikes
▶ 50亿年
之后 rises with its trail
▶ 现在
HUD and gauge fade out
0.6 s still on the lit web: sustained chord, no new events; the cut is continuous into S05
